name: my.lifestory/lifestory
description: Turn 3-10 photos of one person into one AI growing-up video gift.

tools.name: ucp_products_list
tools.description: List available LifeStory AI products with IDs and prices. Start here to learn what can be ordered (currently one product: a growing-up AI video from 3-10 photos of one person).

tools.name: ucp_products_get
tools.description: Get full details of one LifeStory AI product: price, availability, capabilities and variants. Use the product ID from ucp_products_list.

tools.name: ucp_checkout_create
tools.description: Step 1 of the order flow. Creates a checkout session and returns a paymentUrl. The human customer must open paymentUrl in a browser and pay (card) - there is no agent-side payment. After payment, poll ucp_order_status until orderStatus is PAID, then call ucp_order_storyboard.

email.description: Customer email address. The finished video link is emailed here, so it must be the customer's real address.

tools.name: ucp_orders_get
tools.description: Deprecated alias of ucp_order_status: returns the same structured JSON order and generation status. Prefer ucp_order_status.

tools.name: ucp_image_validate
tools.description: Optional helper before ucp_order_storyboard: detects faces in one photo and returns faces, faceCount and isMultiPerson, so you can pick the focal person (selectedFaceIndex or subjectRankInFrame) for multi-person photos.

tools.name: ucp_order_storyboard
tools.description: Step 2 after payment (requires orderStatus PAID, else 402). Generates the per-transition storyboard prompts for the video. Send exactly imageCount images (the quota fixed at checkout), each with either inline base64 `data` or an S3 `key` from POST /api/ucp/orders/{orderId}/uploads/presigned-url (recommended for full-resolution photos; inline base64 is limited by the ~4.5MB request-body cap). Multi-person photos require a focal point (anchor or face selection from ucp_image_validate). Afterwards call ucp_order_generate.

vibeKey.description: Vibe preset: cinematic, warm, playful, elegant, or custom

images.description: Full-resolution base64 images. Server auto-crops to aspectRatio on focal point unless autoCrop:false.

previousState.description: Optional prior storyboard for smart regeneration

tools.name: ucp_order_generate
tools.description: Step 3 (requires orderStatus PAID and a completed ucp_order_storyboard). Starts video generation. Images are optional if already uploaded at the storyboard step. Generation takes minutes; poll ucp_order_status until generation.status is COMPLETED. The video link is emailed to the customer - status responses never include access links.

images.description: Optional if storyboard already uploaded; same schema as storyboard images

prompts.description: Storyboard prompts (imageCount - 1); optional if returned from storyboard step

tools.name: ucp_order_status
tools.description: Poll this throughout the flow: structured JSON with orderStatus (PENDING/PAID), generation status/progress, deliveryReady, and the fulfillment endpoint URLs. Poll after checkout until PAID, then after ucp_order_generate until generation.status is COMPLETED.
